info.title: Backlogg API
info.description:
Backlogg is a unified catalog API for **movies, series, books and games**,
seeded from public external APIs (TMDB, Open Library, IGDB) via a nightly sync,
plus a social layer on top of that catalog.

**Catalog & discovery:** list and detail endpoints per content type, cross-type
`/search` (with on-demand external fallback), `/genres`, `/trending`, `/people`
and similar-item recommendations.

**Social layer:** account management with refresh tokens and account recovery
(`/auth`, `/users`), ratings & reviews, per-user library/backlog, curated
`/lists`, `/follows`, an activity `/feed`, `/notifications` and personalized
`/recommendations`.

**Platform:** rate limiting, structured observability, Prometheus `/metrics`
and response caching.

## Authentication

- **User endpoints** use `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`. Obtain the
  token pair from `POST /auth/login`; renew it with `POST /auth/refresh`.
- **Admin endpoints** (`/admin/*`) require the `X-API-Key` header.

Everything else is public. Direct messaging between users is out of scope.

get.description: Paginated list of catalogued movies (no external fallback); genre filter + sort.
Up to 10 similar movies (TMDB). New items are persisted locally.
Public, paginated ratings & reviews for a movie, newest first.

put.description: Upsert the caller's score/review (full replace); recomputes aggregates. Auth.

delete.description: Remove the caller's rating and recompute aggregates. Requires auth.

put.description: Upsert the caller's backlog status for this movie. Requires auth.

delete.description: Delete the caller's library entry for this movie. Requires auth.

A person (cast or crew) with their credits across the catalog.

post.description: Run a synchronous sync slice and block until it finishes. Requires `X-API-Key`.

get.description: Per-type item counts and last sync timestamp. Requires `X-API-Key`.
Genres with live item counts; optional content-type filter (all types if unset).

get.description: Up to 20 trending movies and/or series (TMDB). New items are persisted locally.

post.description: Create a user account. Rate-limited per IP. Returns the profile including email.
Exchange credentials for an access + refresh token pair. Rate-limited per IP.
Rotate the refresh token and issue a fresh pair. Reuse revokes all sessions.
Revoke the given refresh token. Idempotent. Requires auth.
Send an email-verification link to the caller (logged in dev). Requires auth.
Consume a single-use verification token; marks the email verified. Requires auth.
Send a reset link if the email exists. Identical response either way.
Consume a single-use reset token; changes password and revokes all sessions.

get.description: The caller's own profile, including email. Requires auth.

delete.description: Permanently delete the authenticated user's account and all associated data (ratings, likes, follows, library, lists, notifications, tokens). Frees the username/email for re-registration. Requires auth.

patch.description: Partial update of display_name / bio / avatar_url. Requires auth.

get.description: Public profile by username (no email), with follower/library counts.

post.description: Like a review by id. Idempotent. Notifies the author (not self/re-like). Auth.

delete.description: Remove the caller's like from a review. Idempotent; never notifies. Auth.

get.description: Public, paginated, cross-type reviews by a user, newest first.

post.description: Follow a user. Idempotent; notifies them. Auth; 422 on self-follow.

delete.description: Stop following a user. Idempotent. Requires auth.

get.description: Public, paginated list of a user's followers, newest first.
Public, paginated list of who a user follows, newest first.
Cross-type feed: following (followed users) or popular (30-day top). Auth.
Public, paginated, cross-type backlog for a user; optional status/type filters.

post.description: Create a curated list; slug derived from the title. Requires auth.

get.description: List detail with resolved items in order. Private lists 404 for non-owners.

patch.description: Update title/description/is_public (slug never changes). Owner only.

delete.description: Delete the list and cascade its items. Owner only.

post.description: Append an item at the end. Idempotent. Owner only. 404 if not in catalog.

delete.description: Remove an item and re-pack positions. Idempotent. Owner only.

put.description: Reorder items; payload must match the current items. Owner only. 422 on mismatch.

get.description: A user's lists (public always; private only for the owner). Auth optional.
The caller's notifications, paginated, newest first. Requires auth.
Number of unread notifications for the caller. Requires auth.

post.description: Mark notifications read. Empty body marks all, else only given ids. Idempotent.

delete.description: Delete one of the caller's own notifications. Requires auth. 404 if it doesn't exist or doesn't belong to the caller.

get.description: Personalized cross-type recommendations from the caller's ratings/library. Auth.

post.description: Flag a review as problematic. Idempotent per (reporter, review): the first report returns 201, a repeat returns 200 with the existing report. 404 if the review does not exist, 401 without auth.

get.description: Paginated moderation queue, newest first, filterable by status. Requires `X-API-Key`.

post.description: Mark a report as resolved. Idempotent. 404 if unknown. Requires `X-API-Key`.
Hide a review (a `user_ratings` row) from public listings, the feed and the rating aggregates. Idempotent. 404 if the review does not exist. Requires `X-API-Key`.
Restore a previously hidden review. Idempotent. 404 if the review does not exist. Requires `X-API-Key`.

Ban a user: they can no longer log in or refresh, and all of their reviews become invisible (excluded from listings, feed and aggregates). Idempotent. 404 if the user does not exist. Requires `X-API-Key`.
Lift a ban: the user can log in again and their reviews become visible once more. Idempotent. 404 if the user does not exist. Requires `X-API-Key`.

example.title: Dune

NotificationActorOut.title: NotificationActorOut
NotificationActorOut.description: The user who triggered the notification.

NotificationTargetOut.title: NotificationTargetOut
NotificationTargetOut.description:
Polymorphic target of the notification (null for new_follower).

``item_type``/``slug`` resolve the review's target item (movie/series/
book/game) so a client can link directly to it without a separate
``GET /v1/ratings/{id}`` lookup — there is none. Populated only when
``target_type == "review"``; ``null`` otherwise (including
``new_follower``). ``item_type`` is uppercase (``"MOVIE"``, ``"SERIES"``,
``"BOOK"``, ``"GAME"``) — same convention as the feed endpoints.

RatingIn.title: RatingIn
RatingIn.description: Request body for PUT /{type}/{slug}/rating — full replace (upsert).

ReportOut.title: ReportOut
ReportOut.description: A single review report, as returned to the reporter and the admin queue.

ReportReasonIn.title: ReportReasonIn
ReportReasonIn.description:
Request body for POST /reviews/{id}/report.

``reason`` is an optional short note explaining why the review was flagged.
The whole body is optional, so a bare report with no reason is accepted.

ReportStatus.title: ReportStatus
ReportStatus.description: Lifecycle of a review report; also the ``?status=`` filter values.

ReviewModerationOut.title: ReviewModerationOut
ReviewModerationOut.description: Result of a hide/unhide action on a review (a ``user_ratings`` row).
